Silent reminder

Prayer time, a glance away

Turn on Prayer star in Naqra after choosing your city. It stays above your windows: teal when prayer is over an hour away, yellow at 60 minutes, bright orange at 30, and red at 10. Hover or click to see the next prayer and countdown. Drag to move it.

Questions
& answers

Will reminders work when I close the window?

Yes. Closing the main window leaves Naqra running in the Windows system tray. Floating widgets and enabled reminders keep working. Choosing Exit Naqra stops the app and its reminders. Your computer must be awake.

Can I control the interruptions?

Choose reminder categories and timing, use quiet hours, or pause everything for an hour, a day, or until you resume. Athan can be muted.

How are prayer times set?

Set your location and time zone in Naqra, then choose the calculation method used in your area. Check the results against your local mosque before relying on reminders.

What do I need to install it?

Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit. Download and open Naqra-Setup, click Install, then Launch. Later, open Naqra from the Start menu. This version is for Windows; there is no mobile download.
